item.text:
In my last post, I shared that I was designing a reusable checklist. The checklist is now complete.

I wanted something I could come back to the next time the work came up. Now I have a checklist ready for that next pass.

**Private review note:** The supplied evidence confirms the prior post was published and the checklist is complete. The draft makes no claims about what the checklist contains, whether it has been used, or what results it produces.
